method: Visible interactions in the Codex in-app browser against a local Uvicorn server.
checks: Public example displays model score, flag, and threshold.
Incomplete example displays the missing IFNG error and no prediction.
Changing the selected example clears the previous result.
Uploading a two-specimen public CSV displays both rows with their flags.
Restarting the server with the reproduced model causes the open page to reject the changed model version.
Reloading restores current metadata and scoring.
